name: El Kebeer Awi
overview: Al Kabeer seeks to find love again after his wife was gone, unaware that what he is looking for is closer than he imagines.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: ‎An Upper Egypt elder reveals to his only son before his death that he has a twin brother who immigrated to America with his mother named Johnny, and that he has half the inheritance and the right to assume the mayoralty of the village. But the Saidi son, who calls himself the elder, tries‎‎ to seize wealth and verticality, but Johnny returns and runs for the vertical in front of his brother.‎

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: ‎After Omda of Mazarita discovered that his father had married an American woman and had two twin sons, one of whom was raised in Upper Egypt, the current Omda of the village, and the other grew up in America, who returned to his country in search of his inheritance‎‎ from his father and his position as mayor after his death.‎

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: ‎The third part of the series deals with the reactions of  El Kebeer after the appearance of a new brother named Hazleum, and the appearance of Hazelium is the beginning of a great competitive struggle in a comedy framework between the three brothers El Kebeer, Tony, Hazelium) over the legacy of‎‎ their father after his death, and the attempt of each of them to control and be the owner of the first and last word to win the vertical.‎

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: When Hazal'oum returns from his travels and buys the house, his two brothers, Al-Kabir and Johnny, resent his ownership of all their land and property. The three brothers compete to prove how important they are to the people of Mazarita, as Al-Kabir and Johnny continue to plot to get rid of Hazal'oum.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Al Kabeer seeks to find love again after his wife was gone, unaware that what he is looking for is closer than he imagines.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: After his wedding to Marbouha, Al Kabeer’s adventures take an unexpected turn when Dr. Rabie's mysterious formula transforms his grown son into a child.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: El kebeer Awi, the mayor of the village of Mazarita, is under many pressures, as he finds himself forced to pay attention to the issues and problems around him, and is exposed to comedic situations.
